metadata.title: अबूझमाड़: आदिवासी पर किसकी बंदूक तनी है? Abhujmarh: Who is killing Adivasis
metadata.description: The Abhuj Maria tribes in the interior forests of Bastar division, Chhattisgarh, grapple with not only limited agricultural productivity but also face substantial challenges related to malnutrition and inadequate health facilities. The precarious state of nutrition and healthcare underscores the urgent need for comprehensive interventions to address these pressing issues and improve the overall living conditions of the community. In addition to challenges related to agriculture, malnutrition, and health facilities, the Abhuj Maria tribes in the Bastar division of Chhattisgarh find themselves caught in the crossfire between security forces and Maoist fighters. The conflict further compounds the difficulties faced by the community, exacerbating their vulnerability and necessitating a holistic approach that addresses both security concerns and socio-economic development for a lasting positive impact.
